fit_reason: The firm is an architectural service provider targeting local clients in Romania (Bucharest-based, serving domestic projects). There is no evidence in the source that they specialize in serving the Romanian diaspora, advertise to expats, or have clients abroad. Their services are standard architectural design — not construction monitoring — and they do not mention drone-based progress reporting, remote client servicing, or diaspora-focused outreach. While architects in mid-size cities are part of the ICP, this firm is in Bucharest and shows no diaspora specialization.
